constraints: Report commands must not write to the repository
description: Read-only context, coverage, and intent listing commands that answer what governs a path directly from canonical records
rationale: Telos experiments showed agents cite and honor constraints when the text is surfaced at decision time, and that policy-value and cross-module rules are invisible from diffs alone. Surfacing must stay in the repository: Telos-style sync into instruction files duplicates state that can drift.
requirements: One read-only query returns every active intent, rationale, requirement, severity, and verification status governing a file or directory
Queries default to active intent; retired and superseded intent is returned only on request
Coverage reports bytes and files that no active binding governs as unknown provenance
Reports are recomputed from canonical records and Git snapshots; derived state is never written or copied into instruction files
title: Agent-facing in-repo context queries
